prompts: Use case: identity-preserve. Completely repaint this character as clean high-end 3D fighting game promotional art on a TRANSPARENT background. No props, no origami. Clean digital realism like a polished game character render. Remove the background and all background glow; retain only rim lighting on the figure. Genuine alpha transparency.
